fullGoalSnapshot.title: Entsorgung und Recycling von Batterien und Akkumulatoren bewerten
fullGoalSnapshot.titleEn: Assess disposal and recycling of batteries and accumulators
fullGoalSnapshot.description: Die lernende Person kann Entsorgung und Recycling von Batterien und Akkumulatoren an geeigneten Beispielen fachlich diskutieren und anhand der Umweltfolgen begründet bewerten.
fullGoalSnapshot.descriptionEn: The learner can discuss disposal and recycling of batteries and accumulators using suitable examples and assess them with reasons based on their environmental consequences.

goalPayloadHashDefinition: SHA-256 over UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=false, sorted object keys, separators comma and colon; goal payload before proposed resourceLink

referenceStrategy.strategy: Friendly comic language described in prompt; no copied existing image or layout.

selectedScientificExample: Closed generic non-rechargeable primary battery and closed rechargeable accumulator at end of useful life; no chemistry-specific recovery route is asserted.
selectionReason: Both source types are explicitly required by the prospective goal and bounded fitness finding.

proposedResourceLink.title: Visualisierung: Entsorgung und Recycling von Batterien und Akkumulatoren bewerten
proposedResourceLink.description: Batterien und Akkus getrennt sammeln, Wertstoffe zurückgewinnen und Umweltfolgen abwägen.
proposedResourceLink.altText: Eine geschlossene Einwegbatterie und ein geschlossener Akku führen über eine getrennte Sammlung zu einem Fachbetrieb. Der Betrieb gibt Wertstoffe als Metallstücke und Granulat ab. Darunter stellt eine Waage die Materialrückgewinnung mit einem Blatt dem Energiebedarf und verbleibenden Resten gegenüber.

authorActualInspection.native: Both closed source types have equally large distinct labels. Collection and professional recovery lead to material pieces/granules, not to new or recharged cells. A balance with recovered material/leaf versus energy/residue container makes environmental weighing visible. No handling, opening, combustion or legal rule is depicted.
authorActualInspection.phone360: Both source types, collection arrows, recovered material and weighing remain clearly recognizable. Batterie/Akku/Getrennt sammeln/Wertstoffe/Abwägen are legible; Fachbetrieb/Energie/Reste are smaller but recognizable with their large associated icons.
authorActualInspection.card680: All labels are legible, main route and balance are clear, no crop required.
authorActualInspection.styleAndPerspective: Friendly comic outlines and pale-blue/orange/teal language match the inspected existing primary-cell image. No person or directional work surface. Some scenic greenery is decorative and not evidence of zero impacts.
authorActualInspection.remainingRisks: Material colours/shapes are generic and do not specify a battery composition. The balance is a qualitative decision cue, not a quantitative environmental ranking. The residue icon is not a battery-recovery mechanism.
